question.text: A given quantity of gas is taken from \(A\) to \(C\) in two ways; \(a\) ) directly from \(A \rightarrow C\) along a straight line and \(b\) ) in two steps, from \(A \rightarrow B\) and then from \(B \rightarrow C\). Work done and heat absorbed along the direct path \(A \rightarrow C\) is \(200 \mathrm{~J}\) and \(280 \mathrm{~J}\) respectively

solution.text:
Hint : \(\Delta W=200 \mathrm{~J} \quad \Delta Q=280 \mathrm{~J} \quad\) for path \(A C\)
\(\therefore \quad \Delta U=\Delta Q-\Delta W=280-200=80 \mathrm{~J}\)
\((\Delta U)\) is same for both paths.
\(\therefore \Delta Q=\Delta W+\Delta U=80+80=160 \mathrm{~J}\)
